texts.Volunteers_Approve_Intro: Approve the hours volunteers gave so they count in totals and letters, or reject them with a reason.
texts.Volunteers_HealthCheck_HorizonDetail: These active schedules should have shifts {0} weeks ahead (Weeks Ahead to Create Shifts, Volunteers section) but stop more than two days short, so nobody can sign up for the missing days. The nightly Volunteer Schedules job is usually not running: use the fix for unscheduled nightly jobs. To fill one now, open the schedule and click Create Shifts Now.

texts.Volunteers_HealthCheck_PastShiftsDetail: These shifts ended more than {0} days ago and nobody closed them. Attendance was probably never marked, so the people who came have no hours. Open each shift, mark who came on its Sign-Ups panel, then click Close Shift there, or set Status to Cancelled if it did not happen.
